panels.title: Time since cAdvisor last saw container
panels.description: Freshness for series still returned by Prometheus. Series eventually disappear after staleness; absence is not proof a container stopped.

targets.expr: clamp_min(time() - max by (node_cluster, node_name, container_name, id) (container_last_seen{job=~"cadvisor(-dind)?",node_cluster=~"${node_cluster:regex}",node_name=~"${node_name:regex}",container_name=~"${container_name:regex}",container_name!="",image!="",id!="/"}), 0)

panels.title: Starts observed over selected range
panels.description: Includes starts of cgroups no longer present if their samples remain in the selected range. Not exact restarts; no samples means No data.

targets.expr: sum by (node_cluster, node_name) (max by (node_cluster, node_name, container_name, id) (max_over_time(container_start_time_seconds{job=~"cadvisor(-dind)?",node_cluster=~"${node_cluster:regex}",node_name=~"${node_name:regex}",container_name=~"${container_name:regex}",container_name!="",image!="",id!="/"}[$__range])) > bool time() - $__range_s)

panels.title: cAdvisor scrape availability
panels.description: Node-level scrape health independent of the container filter: 1 means all returned targets are up; 0 means at least one is down. Missing targets remain missing.

targets.expr: min by (node_cluster, node_name) (up{job=~"cadvisor(-dind)?",node_cluster=~"${node_cluster:regex}",node_name=~"${node_name:regex}"})

panels.title: Host context — shared capacity on the selected nodes
Host CPU non-idle
panels.description: node-exporter context; includes I/O wait. Container filtering does not change host statistics.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - avg by (node_cluster, node_name) (max by (node_cluster, node_name, cpu) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",node_cluster=~"${node_cluster:regex}",node_name=~"${node_name:regex}",mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Host memory unavailable
panels.description: MemAvailable includes reclaimable cache. Container working sets are not the complete host memory footprint.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - max by (node_cluster, node_name) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter",node_cluster=~"${node_cluster:regex}",node_name=~"${node_name:regex}"}) / (max by (node_cluster, node_name) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter",node_cluster=~"${node_cluster:regex}",node_name=~"${node_name:regex}"})))

panels.title: Node CPU capacity
panels.description: Logical CPUs reported by node-exporter for each selected node.

targets.expr: count by (node_cluster, node_name) (max by (node_cluster, node_name, cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",node_cluster=~"${node_cluster:regex}",node_name=~"${node_name:regex}",mode="idle"}))

panels.title: Node memory capacity
panels.description: Host RAM per node. Used to reject unlimited/host-sized container memory limits.

targets.expr: max by (node_cluster, node_name) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter",node_cluster=~"${node_cluster:regex}",node_name=~"${node_name:regex}"})

panels.title: Optional process metrics — available on some collectors
Processes and threads
panels.description: Optional cAdvisor process collector. Availability depends on the collector configuration; missing series remain No data.

targets.expr: max by (node_cluster, node_name, container_name, id) (container_processes{job=~"cadvisor(-dind)?",node_cluster=~"${node_cluster:regex}",node_name=~"${node_name:regex}",container_name=~"${container_name:regex}",container_name!="",image!="",id!="/"})

max by (node_cluster, node_name, container_name, id) (container_threads{job=~"cadvisor(-dind)?",node_cluster=~"${node_cluster:regex}",node_name=~"${node_name:regex}",container_name=~"${container_name:regex}",container_name!="",image!="",id!="/"})

panels.title: File descriptors and sockets
panels.description: Optional process metrics; No data indicates missing series, not zero open descriptors.

targets.expr: max by (node_cluster, node_name, container_name, id) (container_file_descriptors{job=~"cadvisor(-dind)?",node_cluster=~"${node_cluster:regex}",node_name=~"${node_name:regex}",container_name=~"${container_name:regex}",container_name!="",image!="",id!="/"})

max by (node_cluster, node_name, container_name, id) (container_sockets{job=~"cadvisor(-dind)?",node_cluster=~"${node_cluster:regex}",node_name=~"${node_name:regex}",container_name=~"${container_name:regex}",container_name!="",image!="",id!="/"})
